neighbours.label: ' any', ' ever' or ' anything' in a yes/no question (Is there any hope?, Has he ever?); the same words in statements and other determiners in questions stay quiet
fire: Is there any milk left in the fridge?
Are there any rooms free tonight?
Has anyone ever seen a ghost here?
Did she ever call you back?
Was there any sign of him?
Is there anything I can do?
Does any bank open on Sunday?
quiet: Is there a carton left in the fridge?
Are there two rooms free tonight?
Has someone seen a ghost here?
Any sign of him would help.
Is there a thing I can do?
Does the bank open on Sunday?
